technology_type:

problem_solved: Short shelf life of cassava tubers limiting transportation and market access
description: The shorter shelf life of cassava tubers (up to 7 days in ambient conditions) limits their marketability and prevents farmers from transporting them to long-distance markets to obtain good prices.The cassava chipping machine helps the farmers to extend the shelf life of cassava tubers in dried form.
applications:
Cassava processing and value-addition enterprises
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agricultural cooperatives
Agri-entrepreneurs and rural processing units
Animal feed and starch manufacturing industries
Government-supported post-harvest management and agro-processing programs
